payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over possible divisor lengths i from 1 to g, checks if n%(i) and m%(i) are 0, then verifies if prefix s1[:i] repeated forms s1 and s2.
payload.rationale: The solution is a simple exhaustive search over candidate lengths; it does not employ backtracking, bitmask, branch and bound, graph search, or permutation enumeration. Search_backtracking is chosen as it is the rule's top suggestion but is a poor fit.
